_readme: WP1 alias map: every legacy German attribute name in live use -> a field_key in lib/fieldSchema.ts.
Source: all 76 distinct i18n.de.attributes[].name values in the parts collection [M 2026-09-01],
plus every name lib/../scraper HEADER_MAP can emit.
Three sentinels carry meaning and are NOT failures:
__not_a_spec : commerce or marketing metadata that must never enter specs_v2
(Zustand = NewCondition, Anwendung = positioning text, Garantie = warranty).
__compat     : a genuine fact that belongs in the compat relation store, not in a spec field.
Duplicating it into specs_v2 would give two sources of truth for one fact.
__backlog    : a real spec for which no field_key exists yet. This is a KNOWN, NAMED gap in
the schema - the thing D4 said we could not express. It is reported by
validate-schema.ts and resolved when the category profile is written.
An incoming name that appears in none of these is UNMAPPED_HEADER: quarantined, never stored
as a field name. That is what stops the free-text drift from coming back.

VALUE-ROUTED ALIASES: a target may be an ORDERED LIST of candidate field_keys. One legacy name genuinely carries different concepts across parts - 'Formfaktor' is SFP+ on one optic and 'LR4' (an optical STANDARD) on the next. The normaliser tries each candidate in order and takes the first that validates; if none does, the value is quarantined as before. Measured 2026-09-01: name->single-key routing quarantined 3,180 values as ENUM_VIOLATION, most of them correct data filed under a name that meant something else.

backlog_notes.Faseranzahl: fiber count (MPO breakout) - needs a transceiver field_key next cycle
backlog_notes.Modultyp: uplink/network module type - likely belongs to a `modules` category profile
backlog_notes.Aufteilung: breakout configuration e.g. 40G->4x10G - candidate transceiver field
backlog_notes.Typ: too vague to map safely; 13 occurrences, all transceiver. Do not guess.
backlog_notes.Dispersionstoleranz: chromatic dispersion tolerance (ps/nm) - long-haul optics field
backlog_notes.Modulation: PAM4/NRZ - real field, add with the 100G+ optics work
backlog_notes.Betriebssystem: switch OS (IOS-XE/NX-OS) - candidate switches field next cycle
backlog_notes.Verschlüsselung: MACsec/link encryption - candidate switches AND transceiver field
